notes: Complete surviving Englebright concrete arch dam: curved ungated ogee overflow crest and tapered downstream/upstream walls, intrinsic raised nonoverflow end/abutment wings, four main tall intermediate crest piers/low end transitions and own maintenance rails/representative construction joints. Static dry structural exterior only; four tall interior piers divide five visibly overflowing central bays in the2010photo. No moving gates, low-level outlet, modeled water/spray/rainbow, adjacent Narrows I/II powerhouses/intakes, river/rock/forest/boats/roads or landscape. Original native NHD dam polygon identifies approximate curved envelope; exact crest/footing/abutment sections and hidden foundations are not surveyed.
